name: CI alerts
ownerWords: stop being paranoid in plan under p45, p221. these should be modeled separately, like in a doc tracking all the known vps infra risks and a duty that checks these. ... things are meant to be first written in plan -> achieved -> cleared & written on duty for maintanence only -> and valiantly persued whenever not met. JUST DO IT
goal: No Grafana alert rule that the alert bridge routes to VP of CI fires, and each one that fires has the bridge's triage job on it. The owner checks this on the Grafana alert list at obs.virev.ai.

metrics.label: Grafana alert rules firing for this chat

onMiss: Each alert_firing line is a Grafana rule that fires now for this chat and the triage job the alert bridge gave it. Steer that job with scripts/job-steer.ts when it ended or went quiet, naming the rule and how long it has fired, and start one job with rlm.create_session for a line with no triage job. Keep the one fix step this metric gets, with the job of the oldest firing rule as its job, and put no step per alert on the plan. A rule that fires on something that is not a fault gets fixed or deleted in grafana/alerting. A source_error means alert-bridge.json could not be read. Tell the owner only when a rule fires for over a day with no fix moving it. All on target: no message.
